title: Tryouts and Locker
author: Lena Villalobos
blurb: Jude Quintana, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, has spent twelve years being so careful it hurts. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
